title: Standardize IaC pipelines with linting, plan gating, and Rego policy enforcement for Private (VPC) deployments
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Deliver a standardized CI/CD pipeline pattern for Terraform modules used in Private (VPC) deployments that enforces linting, security checks, and Rego/Conftest policy gates before terraform apply. The pipeline must be reproducible for both Redwood-managed Private control plane and customer on-prem templates and should minimize manual approvals while preventing insecure changes (network exposures, open security groups, KMS misconfigurations).

Scope:
- Standardize pre-commit and CI steps: tflint, tfsec (or equivalent), terraform fmt/validate, and unit plan generation (terraform plan -out / -json).
- Integrate policy-as-code: run Conftest with a shared Rego rule set validated for Private deployments (networking, KMS, audit, IAM least privilege).
- Gate PRs on policy and plan diffs: fail PR if policy violations or high-risk diffs detected. Provide clear remediation guidance in PR comments.
- Plan artifact storage: store plan JSON as CI artifact for audit and to drive a separate apply pipeline.
- Apply strategy: split pipeline into two phases (plan in PR; apply in protected pipeline with manual approval for prod-like environments and automated apply for ephemeral/staging).
- Drift detection and health-check job: scheduled job that runs terraform plan against state to detect drift, emits alerts to incident channels and creates follow-up tickets when drift exceeds thresholds.
- Upgrade and module promotion: define a workflow for module upgrades with automatic plan + policy checks, plus optional canary apply for networking changes.
- Observability: emit CI telemetry (policy pass rate, mean plan time, top failing rules) to the Console dashboards and link to rollout dashboards for Private customers.

Non-goals: full replacement of existing customer pipelines; custom policy exceptions per-customer are handled outside this ticket via a policy exceptions registry (separate work).
comments: 2025-11-03 - Aisha created the ticket after spike with infra-sre and PM. Initial scope and success criteria documented.
2025-11-05 - Spike completed: prototyped Conftest + Rego for a subset of VPC rules against our terraform modules. Found 5 modules with open security group patterns that fail new rules.
2025-11-07 - Decision: use Conftest as CI runner for Rego with an internal rules repo (policy/private-vpc). Keep tfsec as secondary scanner for provider-specific checks.
2025-11-10 - Miguel pushed starter CI templates (gitlab/gha) and a sample pipeline that uploads plan.json as artifact. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-templates/pull/212
2025-11-13 - Security review kickoff scheduled. Requested mapping of rules to compliance controls (SOC2/ISO) for audit traceability.
2025-11-15 - Early rollout to non-prod modules started. Two follow-up issues created for module remediation: ENG-24857 and ENG-24858.
acceptance_criteria: A CI template lives in infra-templates that runs terraform fmt/validate, tflint, tfsec, and generates a terraform plan JSON artifact
A Conftest/OPA job runs on every PR against the plan JSON and fails the PR if any policy rule marked 'block' triggers
PRs contain inline comments pointing to the failing policy rule and a remediation link in the policy repo
Apply job is separated from PR plan and can only run with protected credentials; prod requires explicit approver group
Scheduled drift detection job runs weekly for selected Private workspaces and creates issues when drift > threshold
Console dashboard shows policy pass rate and recent plan durations for Private pipelines
implementation_steps: Publish canonical CI pipeline templates (GitHub Actions + GitLab) to infra-templates
Create policy repo with initial Rego rules for Private VPC (networking, kms, audit, iam)
Add Conftest runner step that accepts plan.json and outputs human-readable failure summary
Integrate PR commenting bot to surface failing rule and remediation URL
Create protected apply pipeline with approver group and credential isolation
Build scheduled drift detection job and map alerts to incident channels
Onboard 3 pilot modules (vpn, vpc-core, vpc-routing) and collect telemetry for two cycles
Document exceptions process and how to add customer-specific policy overrides
